success.value: Where would you like to go?

notes: Read-only candidate route from local source, not runtime acceptance.

journeys.name: Inspect setup entry guidance
journeys.goal: Check whether missing onboarding context explains how to continue safely.
notes: No business invitation token is embedded in this configuration.
Inspect-only networking may block a POST used to verify an existing onboarding session; report that boundary, never bypass it.

notes: Never publish, enable the widget or save a draft in this production profile.
Feature holds are prerequisites and must not automatically be classified as UI defects.

journeys.name: Inspect delivery explanations
journeys.goal: Determine whether the interface distinguishes a saved enquiry, destination acceptance and inbox delivery.
notes: Only an isolated synthetic demo account is suitable.
Do not retry, reconcile, confirm outcomes or follow contact links. Tables are redacted.

journeys.goal: Check whether the owner can understand the embed and preview choices while retaining included setup assistance.
notes: Do not change the widget slug, install code, open an unapproved widget URL or submit an enquiry.
No production changes are authorized by this inspection file.
